professionalSummary.text: Has released firmware to the installed station fleet over the air and watched charging session success rates after each release.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's experience with firmware release, on-call support, rollout coordination, hardware testing, and release notes. They do not establish the candidate's ability to work with the hardware team or field technicians directly.

decisionBoundary.statement: The candidate's experience with firmware release, on-call support, rollout coordination, hardware testing, and release notes is well-documented, but further human review is required to assess the candidate's ability to work with the hardware team and field technicians.
